abstract: This research develops an expanded unified growth theory that incorporates the endogenous accumulation of physical capital, population, human capital, and technology. The model incorporates a complementarity between physical capital and human capital and can be extended to a multi-country setting with international technology diffusion. The analytical characterization of the mechanisms behind the observed patterns of long-run growth and comparative development delivers a consistent explanation for a large set of seemingly unrelated empirical facts. A quantitative multi-country version of the model matches various empirical regularities of long-run growth dynamics and comparative development patterns that have previously been studied in isolation. The findings also shed new light on the role of the demographic transition for convergence patterns, the specification of cross-country growth regressions, technology spillovers, and the secular stagnation debate.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个扩展的统一增长理论，该理论将物质资本、人口、人力资本和技术的内生积累纳入分析框架。模型引入了物质资本与人力资本之间的互补性，并可扩展至包含国际技术扩散的多国情境。通过对长期增长与比较发展模式背后机制的分析性刻画，该模型为一系列看似无关的实证事实提供了统一的解释。该模型的量化多国版本能够匹配此前被孤立研究的长期增长动态与比较发展模式的多项实证规律。研究结果还揭示了人口转型对趋同模式、跨国增长回归设定、技术溢出效应以及长期停滞争论的新启示。
authors: Matteo Cervellati; Gerrit Meyerheim; Uwe Sunde
title: The Empirics of Economic Growth Over Time and Across Nations: A Unified Growth Perspective
title_zh: 经济增长的实证研究：跨时间与跨国界的统一增长视角

abstract: Under collusion, firms deviate from current profit maximization in anticipation of future rewards. As current profit maximization places little restrictions on firms' pricing behaviour, collusive conduct is hard to infer. Under collusion -- however -- firms' behaviour should instantaneously respond to the anticipation of future changes in their ability to sustain it. We show that bids from certain firms in the Colombian wholesale electricity market collapsed immediately after the announcement, and before the implementation, of a reform that potentially made collusion harder to sustain. A forensic analysis uncovers a type of coordinated behaviour among cartel members that likely required explicit communication and provides suggestive evidence that such communication might have occurred. A quantification exercise supports the reduced-form evidence on collusion and quantifies its costs. Dynamic enforcement constraints should be taken seriously by policy-makers fighting collusion.
abstract_zh: 在合谋状态下，企业会为预期未来收益而偏离当前利润最大化行为。由于当前利润最大化对企业定价行为的约束极小，合谋行为难以被推断。然而，在合谋状态下，企业行为应当会即时响应其对未来维持合谋能力变化的预期。我们研究发现，哥伦比亚批发电力市场中某些企业的报价，在一项可能削弱合谋可持续性的改革方案宣布后、实施前，便立即出现暴跌。法证分析揭示了卡特尔成员间一种很可能需要显性沟通的协调行为，并提供了此类沟通可能存在的暗示性证据。量化分析支持了关于合谋的简约形式证据，并估算了其成本。反合谋政策制定者应严肃对待动态执行约束问题。
authors: Mario Bernasconi; Miguel Espinosa; Rocco Macchiavello; Carlos Suarez
title: Relational Collusion in the Colombian Electricity Market
title_zh: 哥伦比亚电力市场中的关系性合谋
